dashboard.title: Operations dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Live clinic counts for today and your alert inbox.
billing.doctorStep1: Request payment notifies reception/billing — it does not charge the patient.
billing.doctorStep2: Front desk creates an invoice for this visit, issues it, then cashier records payment.
billing.doctorStep3: You can request payment before or after the invoice exists; desk sees invoice status in the alert.
billing.noInvoiceYet: No invoice on this visit yet — desk will create one from Billing.
billing.deskTitle: Doctor payment request vs your invoice
billing.deskIntro: PHOS uses visit-linked invoices. A doctor payment request is a notification to act on this encounter.
billing.requestMeaning: Alert from doctor on an active visit. Open the visit and create or issue the invoice.
billing.invoiceMeaning: Legal bill for the visit (draft → issued → paid). Cashier pays against an issued invoice only.
desk.flow1: Reception — register or find patient → Start visit → triage queue.
desk.flow2: Billing — select visit → Create & issue invoice.
desk.flow3: Cashier — record payment on issued invoice (open cash session for cash).
desk.flowFooter: Billing always ties to a visit (encounter), not the patient file alone.
